sources.title: Myanmar Passport Law
sources.publisher: Ministries of the President's Office, Republic of the Union of Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: Myanmar's official President's Office publication of the 2026 Passport Law distinguishes ordinary passports from special and diplomatic passports and sets their eligibility and validity.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A person entitled to apply for an ordinary passport ... The validity period of an ordinary Myanmar passport shall be five years.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal sets the tourist-entry baseline, names the Chinese-national exception and directs tourist applicants to eVisaCuba.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory ... Tourist visas via internet ... evisacuba.cu.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 tourism F5A visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document expressly makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and sends the visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office

sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Myanmar ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official tourist guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Myanmar visitor and offers electronic tourist-visa issuance online.
conditions: Use a Myanmar ordinary passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a Myanmar ordinary-passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate. The tourist visa is single-entry up to 90 days, potentially extendable once for 90 days.
Work, residence, special or diplomatic passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuba electronic tourist visa
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Myanmar ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.

policies.title: Myanmar ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 F5A service makes an online tourism eVisa available to citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use a valid Myanmar ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket, hotel or host evidence and sufficient funds. F5A is tourism only, single-entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The visa certificate is emailed, so this is electronic issuance rather than online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Work, residence, special or diplomatic passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the Myanmar ordinary passport and upload the tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Myanmar ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the current service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email.
conditions: Apply using the Myanmar ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the official portal excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the Myanmar ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
